items.title: How Moonfrog scales analytics and lowers query cost with Amazon Redshift RG instances
items.summary: Moonfrog Labs migrated a 148 TB Amazon Redshift warehouse from RA3 to Graviton-based RG instances with a single elastic resize. See how the team sized capacity for growing analytics demand, verified warehouse and data lake access, and measured faster loads and lower query cost.
items.creator: Anirudh Chawla
